title: Asymptotic Analysis of Shallow Water Moment Equations
summary: The Shallow Water Moment Equations (SWME) are an extension of the Shallow Water Equations (SWE) for improved modelling of free-surface flows. In contrast to the SWE, the SWME incorporate vertical velocity profile information. The SWME framework approximates vertical velocity profiles using a polynomial expansion with Legendre polynomials and polynomial coefficients, also called moment variables.
